note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (President Lyudvig Chibirov, independent, facing a Communist-led Parliament), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight as a gameplay judgement: a small de facto state after the 1991-1992 war, with influential armed and security structures and a largely rural economy.
